================================================
FILE: models.py
================================================

from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User


class Product(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    count = models.SmallIntegerField(default=0)
    discrp = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    price = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    img  = models.ImageField()
    user = models.ForeignKey(User,on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    def __str__(self):
        return self.name
    class Meta:
        verbose_name="Товар"

                <li><a href="#" class="profile"></a></li>
            </ul>
        </nav>
    </header>

    <main>
        <div class="main-header">
            <h1>Магазин товарів</h1>
            <a href="#"></a> 
        </div>

        <div class="product-grid">
            {% for product in products %}
            <article class="product-card">
                <div class="product-badge yellow">
                    {% if product.count > 0 %}В наявності{% else %}Немає{% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <div class="product-image-container">
                    {% if product.img %}
                        <img src="{{ product.img.url }}" alt="{{ product.name }}" style="width: 100%; height: 180px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 20px;">
                    {% else %}
                        <div class="product-image-placeholder">🛒</div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>

                <div class="product-info">
                    <h3 class="product-title">{{ product.name }}</h3>
                    
                    <div class="product-price-row">
                        <p class="product-price">{{ product.price }} грн</p>
                        <p class="product-weight">{{ product.count }} шт.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="product-description">
                        <p>{{ product.discrp|truncatechars:60 }}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="product-actions">
                        <button class="buy-button">В кошик</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </article>
            {% empty %}
            <p style="text-align: center; width: 100%; grid-column: 1 / -1;">
                Товари скоро з'являться у продажу

from . import views

urlpatterns = [
    path('',views.shop_page, name='shop_page')
]


================================================
FILE: views.py
================================================

from django.shortcuts import render
from .models import Product

def shop_page(request):
    products = Product.objects.all()
    return render(request, 'shop/shop.html', {'products': products})
